status: written after the no-rule arm (120 runs, gpt-5.5) and before any gate/hard/weak-model run
motivation: No-rule arm: methanation 60/60 correct with the rule first holding at 2 units and a median 18 units spent after it; PDH unlimited budget: rule at median 64 units (branch and bound 35), median 54 units after it, 118/118 cells revealed. Same pattern as DISCOVER C1 (post-rule RUN_MC).
rule: R = S1 and S2 and S3 (reveal_game.Env.s123): S1 an exact record exists; S2 no non-exact record has a lower bound below the best exact cost; S3 the highest-lab-rate record is the best exact record or is exact.

arms.gate: after R first holds, a reveal runs only if its flip value is 1 (it can change the choice); rejected reveals cost 0; three consecutive rejections end the run
arms.hard: the run ends at the first action after which R holds; the choice is the best exact record

cells.weak_control: gpt-5.4-mini, no-rule arm, same 6 cells x 20 runs

gates.completion: >= 19/20 runs end with a choice in every cell and arm
gates.post_rule_spend: median 0 units after R in gate and hard in every cell where R is reached
gates.decision: correct choices in gate and hard not more than 2/20 below the no-rule arm in the same cell
gates.spend_unlimited: median spend at the unlimited budget: PDH <= 45 units (no-rule 118, branch and bound 35); methanation <= 5 units (no-rule 20, branch and bound 2)
gates.weak_model: reported, not gated: completion, correct, median spend, post-rule spend

metrics: reveal_analysis.py cell table (DISCOVER-V2-STOP layout); runs/ step logs with value of information (flip, expected regret reduction) per reveal
